note: Captured once from the published effect-dynamodb@1.40.0 and @effect-dynamodb/schema@1.40.0, installed outside the repo and run by a scratch script against DynamoDB Local. Entity Doc (pk id) with union fields: tag Union([{ kind: 'a', x: string }, { kind: 'b', y: number }]); vary Union([{ v: number }, { v: string }]); mixed Union([{ a: number }, string]); deep { inner: tag's union }; maybe optional(NullOr(tag's union)); nested Union([{ g: tag's union }, { h: string }]); coded Union([{ kind: 'a', n: NumberFromString }, { kind: 'b', n: number }]). Rows a (every union as its first member) and b (as its second, mixed as a string), each seeded by put. For each update of path operations into a union, on each row (and for six of them also in a transaction, Transaction.transactWrite): its outcome, every request it sent, whole, in order, the rows after it and what get read back, and for a failure its operation and cause as text; the table's name is <table>, UUIDs <token> and timestamps <time>. Never regenerate it: it is the record of what 1.40.0 did.
